description: Ex-FAP Mi-8T formerly displayed in the Parque 3 de Octubre / Parque El Helicóptero in Pueblo Libre, dismantled there in July 2019 and donated by the Municipalidad de Pueblo Libre to the Municipalidad de Pachacámac, which erected it at the Óvalo Retamal (OpenStreetMap memorial node with that history). Serial not established; no dated 2024-26 photo found.
